record.text: Spider-Man: Brand New Day was so good! What a great way to do a soft reboot and still carry a ton of continuity. 🕷️ 🕸️

I enjoyed Spider-Man: Brand New Day. It was more serious, even somber at times, and traded the usual big-bad formula for something more nuanced. Destin Daniel Cretton (who directed the excellent Shang-Chi movie) built the story around its characters, and the result felt refreshingly grounded.

Spider-Man: Brand New Day really did resonate with me on many emotional and personal levels that I actually felt a lot of emotions that made me feel something, given that it tells a human and relatable story about Peter Parker going through his depression and loneliness which I related to him.
